name: antevo-tremor-watch
description: How many market relationships stopped behaving this week. The Antevo Tremor Index follows 753 pairs of markets in seven families; a pair breaks when its correlation is two standard deviations from its own previous two years. This week against a normal Friday, the families, the new breaks, any week's pairs and every reading since 1997. Public — no account, no key. Read-only; descriptive, not a forecast, not investment advice.
